name: Lime Bubble ♂♂
notes: Two males used together: a lanky Black Lime leaner with a sour stem rub and a compact Sour Bubble leaner with an incense rub, greasy with trichomes at the nodes. Every Run 2 plant caught pollen from both, so each seed is a coin toss for the dad. S. Dot (Sour Dubb × Orange Tahoe) was also seeded but made too few seeds to continue.
